For each of the following matrices, sketch the vector $\xvec = \twovec{1}{0}$ and powers $A^k\xvec$ for $k=1,2,3,4$.

$A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 0 \amp -1.4 \\ 1.4 \amp 0 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 0 \amp -0.8 \\ 0.8 \amp 0 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 0 \amp -1 \\ 1 \amp 0 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

Consider a matrix of the form $C=\left[\begin{array}{rr} a \amp -b \\ b \amp a \\ \end{array}\right] $ with $r=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$. What happens when $k$ becomes very large when

$r \lt 1$.

$r = 1$.

$r \gt 1$.
